about: Public keys only. A three-floor descent (stage-exit-scenarios.py `descent`): Monstro on Basement I, Larry Jr. on Basement II, Mega Fatty on Caves I, then the shared exit into Caves II. route and the Basement I and II legs are EV9BP18Q-descent's. originalFight: the original's own keys from boss-room-arrival to the bottom-left corner of Caves I's boss room. Through Basement II's corner they are EV9BP18Q-descent's fight; then come that fixture's shared Basement II exit and stage transition, and the Caves I route 5 -> 6 -> 7 -> 9 -> 10 -> 11 -> 12 -> 13 -> 0 with every room fought clear, the Mega Fatty kill and the corner hold (S+A 60 frames, released, one frame). The Caves I keys were found once by a research controller, room by room: several seeded variants per room from the same replayed prefix, keeping the one that ended with the most health. A fresh original replays them to the same state. The route is forced (one door chain), and the floor's layout does not depend on the health or coins Basement II leaves. descent: each floor's boss room chain, boss and the original's health after its fight. The Caves I floor gives the port's closed-loop leg its own fight budget and fightFlags (boss-route-record.mjs --dodge --salt 4), which shape only the port's own segment; the original's keys stay this fixed recording. Caves II's generation reads full red health (a Challenge room) and five or more coins (an Arcade); the original ends Caves I at 3 of 6 red and 1 coin, and the port matches the health bit as on the earlier floors (one bomb blast when it ends full). window: the frames from boss-room-arrival to exit-start, set by the original's 47,263-frame segment. originalSolid: none after the fight. originalPickups: the two hearts the original's fight leaves on the floor; the shared walk keeps off them. No curse on stages 1-4 for this seed.
